title: Warren runs wild as Colts fall 34-22 on road to Steelers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Warren runs wild as Colts fall 34-22 on road to Steelers
sources.description: The Indianapolis Colts could not capitalize on their goal-to-go opportunities and fell 34-22 Sunday to the Pittsburgh Steelers at Arcisure Stadium. Indy’s offense missed two chances to plunge into the end zone from short field distance, while its defense allowed Jaylen Warren to lead the game in both rushing and receiving by piling up 188 […]
